The Hope
詞／曲：劉蜚聲 Faye Liu
英譯詞：基督城靈糧堂

lines.a: 我放下自己 來到祢座前
lines.b: I lay myself down, come before Your throne

lines.a: 聖靈降下平靜我的心 在祢愛裡
lines.b: Holy Spirit, come and calm my heart, In Your love

lines.a: 天父祢為我重新得生命
lines.b: Father, You breathe new life into me

lines.a: 與自己分離 與我更靠近
lines.b: Leaving the old me behind

lines.a: 相遇基督裡
lines.b: Drawing closer to You

lines.a: 我把自己全人交給祢
lines.b: I surrender all of me to You

lines.a: 全心交給祢
lines.b: My whole heart to You

lines.a: 獻上這心靈 誠實敬拜 在祢同在裡
lines.b: Offer up my spirit, worship in truth here in Your presence

lines.a: 負擔和重擔都交給祢
lines.b: All my burdens I give to You

lines.a: 在祢腳前哭泣
lines.b: Weeping at Your feet

lines.a: 跟隨祢心意 我願意
lines.b: I'll follow Your heart - Yes, I will

lines.a: 天父祢同在 使我靈安息
lines.b: Father, Your presence brings rest to my soul

lines.a: 心思和意念都屬於祢 傾聽祢聲音
lines.b: My mind and my thoughts belong to You, hear Your voice

lines.a: 耶穌來親自帶領我生命
lines.b: Jesus, come and lead my life Yourself

lines.a: 每個決定 每一個腳印
lines.b: Every choice I make, every step I take

lines.a: 都在基督裡
lines.b: All in Christ alone

lines.a: 我把自己全人交給祢
lines.b: I surrender all of me to You

lines.a: 全心交給祢
lines.b: My whole heart to You

lines.a: 獻上這心靈 誠實敬拜 在祢同在裡
lines.b: Offer up my spirit, worship in truth here in Your presence

lines.a: 負擔和重擔都交給祢
lines.b: All my burdens I give to You

lines.a: 在祢腳前哭泣
lines.b: Weeping at Your feet

lines.a: 祢的話語是 我生命
lines.b: Ev'ry word You speak is my life

lines.a: 跟隨祢心意 我願意
lines.b: I'll follow Your heart - Yes, I will
